candidates.description: 宣布下一个问题是历史

candidates.transcript_evidence: So who was the first president of the United States?
candidates.description: 询问美国第一任总统是谁

candidates.transcript_evidence: Was it Thomas Jefferson? Was it John Adams? George Washington? Or James Madison?
candidates.description: 列出几个可能的总统选项

candidates.transcript_evidence: So Jefferson was actually the third president, but he did draft the Declaration of Independence.
candidates.description: 指出杰斐逊是第三任总统但起草了独立宣言

candidates.transcript_evidence: So George Washington was the first president, and he led the revolution, yeah.
candidates.description: 确认华盛顿是第一任总统并领导了革命

candidates.transcript_evidence: But I think because they were all involved in the early stages, it goes Washington, then John Adams, then Jefferson, and then James Madison, but they were all involved in the Declaration of Independence, the revolution, and the Constitution.
candidates.description: 阐述早期总统顺序及他们对建国文件的参与
